'''Level 159''' was located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It was a run down level, filled with garbage and with many [[luma-panel]]s broken and not working. [[Boddu Bocck]] maintained an apartment on Level 159.<ref name="IDC" />
